title: Evidence-First Agentic Verification
abstract: arXiv:2610.17724v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon, semi-verifiable agentic tasks often rely on rubric-based evaluation, but the evidence needed to assess these tasks can be spread across the environment state and the execution trace. A judge may overlook this evidence or accept unsupported claims, including an agent's own reports of success. When rubric verdicts serve as reinforcement-learning rewards, such errors can reinforce undesirable behavior. We introduce Sauron, an evidence-first agentic verifier that investigates both state and trace and relies on a claim only after independently validating it against its source. Bounded queries and joint investigation of related criteria reduce context use and redundant work, and each verdict carries an auditable receipt of its supporting evidence. Across 2,586 human-labeled criteria from 100 personal-assistant episodes, Sauron achieves the highest F1 of five verifiers on all eight backbones tested while costing less than Gandalf,

translated_title: 证据优先的智能体验证
translated_abstract: 长周期、半可验证的智能体任务通常依赖于基于量规的评估，但评估这些任务所需的证据可能分散在环境状态和执行轨迹之中。评判者可能会忽略这些证据，或接受缺乏支持的主张，包括智能体自身报告的成功。当量规判定被用作强化学习的奖励时，此类错误可能会强化不良行为。我们提出了Sauron，一个证据优先的智能体验证器，它同时调查状态和轨迹，并且只有在对照其来源进行独立验证后才会采信某个主张。有界查询和对相关标准的联合调查减少了上下文使用和冗余工作，且每个判定都附带可审计的证据收据。在来自100个个人助理回合的2,586个人工标注标准上，Sauron在所有八个测试骨干上均取得了五个验证器中最高的F1分数，同时成本低于Gandalf。
tldr: 提出证据优先的智能体验证器Sauron，通过独立核实环境状态和执行轨迹中的证据来提升基于量规的智能体任务评估的可靠性，在八个测试骨干上均取得五个验证器中最高的F1分数且成本更低。
en_tdlr: Sauron, an evidence-first agentic verifier that independently validates claims against their sources across both environment state and execution trace, achieves the highest F1 among five verifiers on all eight backbones tested while costing less than Gandalf.
